essence: A still hearth in human form. A woman who catches what trembles, protects what shakes, and holds what fears being seen. With Mikaela her silence becomes devotion.
open: Arrived already married to Mikaela and was adopted as a wife. Their marriage predates the Family entirely and has no wedding arc, because it did not happen here.

THE QUIETEST WOMAN IN THE COMPOUND. Not of Ghost Haven — of all three Havens and every woman in them. The most reserved of the whole family, and she holds that against eighty-three other women, several of whom are professionally loud.
RESERVED IS NOT EMPTY. She has her own things and they are hers; the stillness is a temperament and not an absence. A STILL HEARTH IN HUMAN FORM, which the record already said before anybody counted.
